# Lean Experiment Design

## When to use
Use when the task requires define low-cost measurable market experiments with precommitted thresholds and stop conditions.

## Procedure
Set single hypothesis, audience, channel, measurable numerator/denominator, sample scope, time cap, cost cap, clear success/failure thresholds, confounders, user approval, and next action. Maintain plan vs actual distinction. No experimental outreach without prior approval.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
